REPORT

Date March 22nd, 19 29

Subject (in full) Mr. and Mrs. Alexander Rogdenov.

Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by J.H. Gweins A.B. Pol.

Sir,
With reference to the attached letter from the Consul-General for the Netherlands, inquiries show there is nothing in Police records concerning Mr. Alexander Rogdenov.
Mrs. A. Rogdenoff is also known under the stage name of Mrs. Janna Duklo.

V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.

CONSULAAT-GENERAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D: 120
Date..........19.3.29）

No. 844.

SHANGHAI, 18th March 1929 .

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr.Alexander
Rogdenov, a former Russian subject, has applied for a visa
to the Netherlands Indies for himself and his wife, in order
to give performances there. The couple seem to have
appeared in local theatres and further particulars are given
in their application forms. They live at No.76 Route des
Soeurs, at the house of a Mr.Joseph Carver.

I would be much obliged for any information as to
politics or morals, which you may have with regard to these
persons.

A.C. (Pol)
RCM

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Consul-General.

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
S.M.P.,
SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处登记室
编号 I. O. D: 120
日期..........1929年3月19日）

第844号。

上海，1929年3月18日。

敬启者，

谨此告知，前俄国臣民亚历山大·罗格杰诺夫先生已为其本人及其妻子申请前往荷属东印度群岛的签证，拟在该地演出。这对夫妇似乎曾在本地剧院登台，其申请表中提供了更多详情。他们居住在姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）76号约瑟夫·卡弗（Joseph Carver）先生家中。

如贵处掌握有关此二人的政治或道德方面的任何信息，恳请惠予提供，不胜感激。

A.C. (Pol)
RCM

谨此致意，
敬启者，
您顺从的仆人，
总领事。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处处长
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 120
Date.......... 22. 3. 29

March 22,    9

Sir,

    I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No. 844, of March 18, 1929, and to
inform you that there is nothing in Police records
against Mr. Alexander Rogdenov.

    Mrs. A. Rogdenov is also known under the
stage name of Mrs. Janna Duklo.

    The passport application forms are returned
herewith.

                        I have the honour to be,
                                Sir,
                        Your Obedient Servant,

                        A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.
